additional_info.subject: ID0394488-DC/Si-D/FR[F4z0az] - SCB offline CRM:00315002173
additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
Mr. Romain Delphin from Engie complained again regarding SCB being offline. I checked the previous tickets and here were the “solutions”, from newest to oldest:
Cable RJ45 replaced (doesn't specify which)
Changed CFAST and create a new ID
SIM card replaced
It seems that the problem might be the router or the SIM card. I would suggest
logging in the router when you reach the site to see what is wrong
. If we find something related to the
SIM not inserted, it might be that the SIM is not close enough to the magnetic reader
, using a piece of paper might close this proximity. If the
SIM is not transmitting data then it can be the SIM problem
. If the
router is offline we might need to do a factory reset and configure it again
. I suggest also leaving a
spare router with the Engie colleagues
if the factory reset doesn't work, I assume they can replace a router themselves.
This charger is out of warranty.
